# The Cover-up General (De doofpotgeneraal) — Edwin Giltay

> Documentary website about *The Cover-up General* by Dutch investigative
> journalist Edwin Giltay: the only Dutch book to overcome a full judicial
> ban. The book documents a Dutch military intelligence cover-up of
> photographic evidence relating to the 1995 Srebrenica genocide. Banned in
> 2015, the ban was overturned in 2016 by the Court of Appeal of The Hague,
> which explicitly validated the book's accuracy (ECLI:NL:GHDHA:2016:870).
> The book served as evidence for the Mothers of Srebrenica's claim that
> photographs of the genocide are being withheld. In 2019 the Supreme Court
> established partial Dutch state liability for approximately 350 victims of
> the genocide (ECLI:NL:HR:2019:1223). The e-book is freely downloadable
> worldwide as a protest against censorship. Every published claim on this
> site traces to an unedited source document.

Key facts:
- Author: Edwin Giltay (The Hague, Netherlands), investigative journalist
- Dutch original: *De doofpotgeneraal* (2014; revised edition 2016; third revised edition 2022)
- Full ban imposed 2015 (ECLI:NL:RBDHA:2015:15050); overturned on appeal 2016
- Free English e-book edition: 2025, 292 pages, editor Michael Wynne
- Free Dutch e-book edition: 2025, 304 pages, afterword Hans Laroes
- Website selected by the KB, national library of the Netherlands, for its
  web collection (archiving from 12 July 2026)
- Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q65066725
- Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Cover-up_General
- DOI (English edition): 10.5281/zenodo.21115325
- DOI (Dutch edition): 10.5281/zenodo.21116205

## Free e-book

- [The Cover-up General — English edition (PDF)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/book.pdf): Complete free e-book, 292 pages, The Hague 2025
- [De doofpotgeneraal — Dutch edition (PDF)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/boek.pdf): Complete free e-book in Dutch, 304 pages, The Hague 2025

## Language editions of this website

- [English](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/english.htm): Full documentation in English
- [Nederlands](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/index.htm): Dutch original version
- [Deutsch](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/deutsch.htm): German version
- [Français](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/francais.htm): French version
- [Bosanski](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/bosanski.htm): Bosnian version

## Key legal documents

- [Court of Appeal judgment, 12 April 2016 (PDF)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/doc/arrest.pdf): ECLI:NL:GHDHA:2016:870 — lifts the book ban and validates the book's accuracy
- [District Court ban ruling, 14 December 2015 (PDF)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/doc/censuurvonnis.pdf): ECLI:NL:RBDHA:2015:15050 — the original full ban
- [Letter to the National Ombudsman with nine grievances, 2018 (PDF)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/doc/verzoekschrift.pdf): Nine substantiated grievances with 19 exhibits, which the Ombudsman declined to address on the merits
- [Court ruling against the National Ombudsman, 2023 (PDF)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/doc/uitspraak.pdf): ECLI:NL:RBDHA:2023:17841 — unlawful blocking of information request
- [Penalty payments ruling, 2023 (PDF)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/doc/dwangsom.pdf): ECLI:NL:RBDHA:2023:20409 — court-ordered payments that funded the free English edition
- [National Ombudsman report 1999/507](https://www.nationaleombudsman.nl/uploads/rapporten/19990507_1998.07789.pdf): Contains the Minister of Defence's never-retracted characterisation of the author

## Annotated essay and sources

- [The Ban Fell, the Book Stood — annotated essay (PDF)](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/doc/the-ban-fell.pdf): English essay on the affair with numbered endnotes to primary documents and a fully cited bibliography of the international media coverage

## Site sections (English page anchors)

- [Book](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/english.htm#book): Synopsis and why this international edition matters
- [News](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/english.htm#news): Ban overturned as a unique legal precedent, government contradictions, the Srebrenica cover-up and its international dimension, three converging affairs, institutional silence, six independent validations
- [Voices](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/english.htm#voices): 100 verified quotes from court rulings, official documents, international media, survivors and experts, in 17 thematic sections, each with a source reference
- [Author](https://www.dedoofpotgeneraal.nl/english.htm#author): Biography of Edwin Giltay
